purpose: Teach: 菅野/岩国/西宮/さいたま/前川/河村/鎌田/北川

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、菅野氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Your father — when he was young, he launched a joint venture with Sugano.
lines.style: Quiet, measured pace. Gentle lift at the period, as if recalling something precious. Eyes soft with memory. No rush.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは岩国の工場の初代責任者だった
lines.en: Yes. He was the first plant manager in Iwakuni.
lines.style: Clear, present-tense conviction. Steady eye contact. Honoring the memory with directness, not elaboration. Slight weight on 「初代」.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、西宮にお勤めだった
lines.en: Your father — when he was young, he worked in Nishinomiya.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Slight pause before the location, as if searching for the right word. Gentle trailing-off. The voice of someone letting old details surface.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはさいたまでの新事業を成功された
lines.en: Yes. He made a success of the new venture in Saitama.
lines.style: Firm acknowledgment. Respect in the delivery of 「成功」 — not boastful, but assured. Grounded tempo. The tone of someone who knows what he's saying is true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、前川氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: Your father — when he was young, he planned the overseas expansion with Maekawa.
lines.style: Eyes distant with memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. Warmth underneath — pride in the ambition. Voice stays low and measured.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは河村氏を経理の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. He placed Kawamura as the cornerstone of accounting.
lines.style: Considered, deliberate. Slight emphasis on 「柱」 — the weight of that choice. Speaking as someone who understands the architecture of legacy. Calm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、鎌田氏と新製品を開発された
lines.en: Your father — when he was young, he developed new products with Kamada.
lines.style: Tender, faraway quality. Slight uplift on 「新製品」 — genuine interest in what was built. Breath carries the weight of time passed. Quiet.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは北川氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. He entrusted Kitagawa with all legal matters.
lines.style: Slow, respectful close. Weight on 「委ねられた」 — the trust implicit in delegation. Voice settles. Final nod of acknowledgment. Grounded, at peace.
